listing.title: My First Easter & Spring Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Easter & Spring Pages – Bunny, Egg, Chick & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book for Easter and spring!

Little hands color 30 Easter and spring pictures, from an Easter bunny hugging a spotted egg, a basket of eggs and a chick wearing its eggshell as a hat to a smiling tulip, rain boots, an umbrella and a blossom tree. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, lots of them with smiling faces, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Easter fun: Easter Egg, Easter Bunny, Easter Basket, Chocolate Bunny, Jelly Beans, Egg Hunt, Bunny Ears, Easter Bonnet, Painted Eggs, Bunny Slippers and Carrots
  • Baby animals and garden friends: Chick, Lamb, Duckling, Fawn, Baby Bunny, Frog, Robin's Nest, Caterpillar, Butterfly and Bumblebee
  • Spring flowers and rainy days: Tulip, Daffodil, Flower Pot, Watering Can, Sprout, Rain Boots, Umbrella, Kite and Blossom Tree
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
